title: AI Agent(s) for Enrollment Management – Student Services
summary: WSU seeks autonomous AI agents for recruitment, enrollment communications, 24/7 student/family support, and future retention/advising workflows.
why_it_matches: Core enrollment-management domain — Risely's primary product area
Recruitment outreach, FAFSA nudges, and 24/7 support are agent-ownable workflows
Explicit retention and advising expansion into the Advisor product
High strategic value through WIPHE cooperative purchasing
risks: Requires references at similar public four-year institutions
recommended_action: GO — strong fit for Risely Enrollment, with Advisor as the expansion path.

title: Student Advising & Retention Support Platform
summary: CU Boulder seeks a platform to support academic advising, proactively flag at-risk students, and reduce advisor caseload through workflow automation.
why_it_matches: Squarely in Risely's advising / student-success domain
At-risk outreach and caseload reduction are agent-ownable workflows
Reducing advisor load maps directly to the Advisor product
Automation framing means a shorter education curve on the AI angle
risks: Framed as an analytics platform — autonomous-agent value still needs to be sold
EAB Navigate and Civitas are likely incumbent competitors
recommended_action: MAYBE — strong domain fit for Advisor. Lead with workflow outcomes and expect to sell the agent angle against incumbents.

title: Donor Relations & Alumni Engagement CRM Replacement
summary: Allegheny College seeks to replace its legacy donor CRM with a modern platform for alumni engagement tracking, gift officer activity management, and campaign reporting.
why_it_matches: Sits in Risely's advancement / alumni-engagement domain
risks: Scope is a system-of-record (CRM) replacement, not an engagement workflow an agent could own
Small private liberal arts college — limited deal size
Raiser's Edge and Salesforce Nonprofit are likely targets
No agent-ownable workflow in scope today
recommended_action: PASS — in our field, but it's a CRM swap rather than an agent opportunity. Re-engage if a future RFP describes donor outreach or engagement automation.
